title: Callbacks to promises across two files
prompt: db.js has a callback API and users.js is a pile of nested callbacks on top of it. Make get and set in db.js return a promise when no callback is passed (callbacks must keep working for other code), then rewrite users.js with async/await: loadUser(id) and renameUser(id, name) return promises, resolve to the same values the callbacks delivered, and reject with the same errors.
